description:
FOUNDING ENGINEER, AI — SHIPLIGHT AI

 - Do you agree we’re living through the AI revolution?

 - Do you want to be part of it — and run ahead of the curve?

 - Are you ready to help 100x productivity?

If so, join us.

At Shiplight AI, our mission is to build the foundation for enterprise-scale automation powered by intelligent agents. We believe every organization should have AI systems that can understand context, take action, and collaborate seamlessly with humans — transforming how work gets done across the enterprise.

Our first mission: fully automate software quality assurance. We’re building state-of-the-art agentic QA systems that integrate deeply into the software development cycle — empowering every product manager, developer, and tester with their own AI QA engineer that validates work in real time.

You’ll be joining a small, mission-driven founding team led by industry veterans, working at the intersection of AI agents, system engineering, and real-world developer productivity.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build core systems that enable AI agents to autonomously test and reason about complex applications.

 - Design, prototype, and ship agentic browser and device automation components.

 - Work directly with the founders to define architecture, roadmap, and company culture.

 - Experiment with cutting-edge context engineering techniques to improve reasoning and adaptability.

 - Move fast — from prototype to production — with high ownership and autonomy.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Mission-driven — you want to help shape the next era of AI-powered software development.

 - Curious and resourceful — you love solving hard, open-ended problems.

 - Hands-on builder — you thrive in early-stage environments with high speed and uncertainty.

 - Collaborative — you value teamwork and open technical debate.

 - You have 1–3 years of startup experience in the AI domain.

 - You’re eager to grow into a technical leader and make a massive impact early.




IDEAL SKILLS

 - Strong engineering fundamentals and product mindset.

 - Proficiency in Python and TypeScript.

 - Deep understanding of context engineering and prompt-based reasoning systems.

 - Familiarity with browser automation, mobile automation, or QA tooling is a plus.

 - Comfortable working across the stack — backend, frontend, and AI interfaces.




LOCATION

 - San Francisco Bay Area — hybrid preferred.

 - We move fast, iterate face-to-face, and believe early teams build the strongest culture.




WHY JOIN NOW

 - Join at the earliest stage as the first founding engineer.

 - Shape both the product and technical vision.

 - Work directly with founders who’ve built successful systems and products before.

 - Receive generous equity and play a defining role in the company’s success.
